children: Amerant completed a registered public offering of $50 million 7.00% Senior Notes due 2031, entering an underwriting agreement with Raymond James and executing a Base and First Supplemental Indenture with Bank of New York Mellon as trustee. The notes, unsecured and unsubordinated, pay interest semi-annually and mature on September 17, 2031. The offering closed on September 17, 2026, delivering approximately $48.4 million in net proceeds. Amerant intends to use the proceeds for general corporate purposes, including working capital, organic bank growth, debt repayment, and potential share repurchases.
